messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

We have a tool "vegan_restaurant_find_nearby" which takes location as string and optional operating_hours with default 21. We need to call it three times? Or maybe we can pass multiple locations? But the function signature expects one location per call. So we should call it separately for each location. Also note that the user didn't specify an explicit operating_hours param; but they said "at least 10pm". That means we set operating_hours=22. We'll do separate calls:

1. For Los Angeles, CA -> location="Los Angeles, California"
2. For San Francisco, CA -> location="San Francisco, California"
3. For Seattle, WA -> location="Seattle, Washington"

We'll use operating_hours=22 for all.

But also check if there's a requirement about timezone? Not needed.
